column1: # V8b CARRIER-ATTRIBUTION panel (Ludmil, 25 Sep report, section 4 V8b).
# "Separately compare genuine pks reads against alternative pks-positive carriers/strains
#  (pks+ E. coli, Klebsiella, Citrobacter, Enterobacter, etc.). This asks which organism
#  is the likely carrier and should not be conflated with locus-detection specificity."
# Every member here is meant to be pks/clb POSITIVE. This is the opposite screen to
# IHE3034 island against each downloaded genome and keeps a candidate only if island
# coverage is at or above --min-carrier-island-coverage. Candidates that fail are written
# to v8b_pks_screen.tsv with status=rejected_not_pks_positive and left out, because a
# pks-negative "carrier" can never win a read and would only inflate the panel.
# The rows are CANDIDATES, not assertions. Which strains carry the island is exactly what
# the screen decides, from the sequence, on the day the panel is built -- not from this
# file and not from a citation. Carriers are named by strain, never collapsed to genus,
# so an attribution can say "this read fits K. pneumoniae SGH10's island as well as
# IHE3034's" rather than the much weaker "it is Klebsiella". As it happens the screen
# rejected NTUH-K2044, the strain most often named as THE pks+ Klebsiella: its assembly
# carries none of the island. That is the whole reason the screen exists.

column5: The pipeline's own reference. In this panel it is one carrier among several, not the answer: every other member competes with it on equal terms.
B2 probiotic strain; the most widely sequenced non-IHE3034 pks+ E. coli.
B2 uropathogenic strain from the same clonal background as IHE3034.
B2 uropathogen; a second independent B2 island copy.
B2 asymptomatic-bacteriuria strain; tests how far within-B2 island divergence goes.
B2 uropathogen included as a candidate precisely because its pks status is the kind of thing that should be decided by the screen, not assumed.
Hypervirulent K1 ICEKp10 reference strain, kept as a candidate because "hypervirulent K1" is often treated as a synonym for clb+; the screen is what decides.
Hypervirulent K1 ICEKp10 genome; clbB of this assembly is in the NCBI identical-protein group of IHE3034 ClbB.
Complete-genome clinical K. pneumoniae whose clbB is in the same NCBI identical-protein group as IHE3034 ClbB (WP_001518711.1).
Second independent complete-genome K. pneumoniae from that same identical-protein group: two Kp strains, not one, so an attribution to Kp is not an attribution to one assembly.
Complete-genome K. aerogenes (formerly Enterobacter aerogenes) from the IHE3034 ClbB identical-protein group: the genus the island was first reported in, with an assembly that actually carries it.
The K. aerogenes type strain, which sits in the phase-1 DECOY panel. Kept here as a candidate so the screen settles, on sequence, which panel it belongs in.
Citrobacter koseri is one of the original reported pks-island carriers.
Second complete-genome C. koseri, so Citrobacter attribution does not rest on a single assembly.
Complete-genome Enterobacter whose clbB is in the IHE3034 ClbB identical-protein group: the Enterobacter arm Ludmil names.
A second Enterobacter candidate with no clb evidence, kept so the panel records a screened Enterobacter negative alongside the positive one.
